General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging

What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Transfer Case Gasket, Oil Seal and Pin Kit.
These are the most reliable oil seals made and a must have on a professional repair job.
Comes with the Gaskets, Oil Seals and Guide Pins for both the Front & Center Cases.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Gasket, Front Case
Qty 1 – Gasket, Center Case
Qty 2 – Oil Seal #3050
Qty 1 – Oil Seal #0050
Qty 1 – O Ring, Speedometer Gear
Qty 3 – Pinion Flange Nuts
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
